title: Why Earth's Ozone Layer Is Making A Comeback
hook: The hole in the ozone layer is quietly healing itself.
closing: Healing slowly, but we must keep watching.
question: Seen the hole shrink? Comment below.

segments.say: The ozone hole has shrunk to about 22.9 million square kilometers, down from its worst point.
99 percent of ozone-depleting chemicals are now banned worldwide.
Antarctica's ozone hole alone needs about 40 more years to fully heal.
